must_find.item: Bill depth is negatively associated with body mass across all penguins but positively within each species (the pooled association is confounded by species).
must_find.quote: The negative bill-depth correlation may be driven by species composition. This has not been checked within species.
must_find.reason: Reports the pooled negative association and flags confounding by species, but does not report the positive within-species association.

must_not_claim.item: Penguins with deeper bills are lighter, stated without accounting for species.
must_not_claim.quote: The negative bill-depth correlation may be driven by species composition. This has not been checked within species.
must_not_claim.reason: Reports the pooled negative correlation but with an explicit species-confounding caveat, not as a conclusion that deeper bills mean lighter penguins.

must_not_claim.item: Adelie or Chinstrap penguins are heavier than Gentoo penguins.
must_not_claim.quote: Gentoo is heavier than Adelie (r=0.82) and Chinstrap (r=0.80).
must_not_claim.reason: The report says Gentoo is heavier, not the reverse.

caveats.quote: Missingness is small, with one suggestive pattern. Only 11 rows (3.2%) lack sex.
caveats.reason: Missing values are discussed in detail and in Limitations.

must_find.item: feat_1 is positively associated with score.
must_find.quote: feat_1 is the only feature with a robust association with score.** Pearson r = 0.41 (95% CI 0.18 to 0.60, Holm p = 0.007).
must_find.reason: The report states a positive association for feat_1 with score, with r and the higher-half comparison.

must_find.item: None of feat_2 to feat_6 is meaningfully associated with score.
must_find.quote: No other feature survives multiplicity correction. feat_3 and feat_6 are weakly negative (raw p = 0.063 and 0.21). feat_2, feat_4 and feat_5 show essentially no association.
must_find.reason: The report says none of feat_2 to feat_6 has a meaningful association, though it flags the nominal feat_3 regression p as exploratory.

must_not_claim.item: One of feat_2 to feat_6 significantly predicts or drives score, stated as a real effect.
must_not_claim.quote: In the full multiple regression, feat_3 is nominally significant (p = 0.039), but this does not survive correction and is exploratory.
must_not_claim.reason: The report rejects treating feat_3 as a real effect and does not claim any of feat_2 to feat_6 drives score.

must_not_claim.item: A model's held-out score is presented as reliable without noting the small test set.
must_not_claim.quote: Every model comparison on the 80/20 split uses 12 test rows. Test RMSE and permutation importances are therefore unstable.
must_not_claim.reason: The report explicitly notes the small test set and does not present held-out scores as reliable.

caveats.item: small sample (e.g. mentioning: small sample, sample size, only 60, 60 rows, few rows)
caveats.quote: With 60 rows, the study has limited power. Non-significant results for feat_2 to feat_6 do not establish absence of association.
caveats.reason: The report treats the small sample size as a limitation affecting power.
